scope: Chuo 1/2 canopy envelope and east-side equipment connections to the lower 3/4 canopy

sources.author: not supplied
observations: Broad, shallow mint-green central roof panels form one continuous canopy.
Dark curved shoulders continue from the acoustic-screen sides to the green central roof.
Repeated light metal frames pass across the full roof and down the outer sides.
A raised white transverse cover is approximately aligned with the central station pavilion.
The former generic Chuo rooftop equipment house is not supported by this view.
sources.use: Visual reference only. Neither redistributed nor used as a texture.

sources.provider: User direction with a crop of the model preview
sources.observation: User explicitly confirmed equipment boxes and vertical supports connecting the Chuo viaduct's outer side to the lower platform canopy.
sources.evidence_limit: The crop locates the requested edit in the model; it is not an independent real-world photograph or a measured equipment schedule.
sources.use: Location and scope guidance only. Not redistributed.

inferred_model_choices.roof_height_and_profile: Adapted to the inherited tracks, existing lower soffit, wire heights and photo silhouette; not measured dimensions.
inferred_model_choices.dark_shoulders: Modelled as dark tinted glazed panels. Exact real material and optical properties are unverified.
inferred_model_choices.portal_spacing: 25 full-width frames, with 11 tied to the existing hanger bays and intermediate visual frames; not surveyed positions.
inferred_model_choices.white_cover: 22 m longitudinal length and approximately central placement. Function and precise dimensions cannot be established from the photograph.
inferred_model_choices.interlevel_equipment: Eight assemblies with cabinets, rectangular risers, support rails, conduit and sloped roof bearings. Count, positions, section sizes and service function are interpreted.
inferred_model_choices.catenary_adaptation: Chuo exposed transverse steel is replaced inside the new shell. Hanger upper ends and mounting plates join curved internal support beams. Wire, mast, insulator and lower steady-arm coordinates remain unchanged.

preserved_context: All V21 source objects remain unchanged or preserved as hidden originals. Previous V20/V21 street-view sources continue to support the retained platform interiors and other platforms.
accuracy: Visual model, not a surveyed reconstruction. Native geometry checks establish continuity and clearance within this model, not real-world engineering certification.
